items.raw_excerpt: Fancy some extra sick days for when your kids pick up a daycare bug? Or an on-site nanny to let you bring your kids to work with you?

items.title_en: Sturt and Norwood revive a 48-year-old grand final argument

items.summary_en: Fishermen in North Queensland raise money for an independent review. They hope the review can overturn the gillnet ban. A ban on gillnets puts the local seafood industry at risk.

items.raw_excerpt: Throughout the algal bloom crisis, citizen scientists off the coast of South Australia helped with research. Now, with deadly bird flu impacting wildlife, they are taking to the ocean to keep watch.
items.summary_en: Volunteer scientists in South Australia once helped study an algal bloom. Now a deadly bird flu is hurting wildlife, so they are going out to sea to keep watch on dolphins.

items.raw_excerpt: Countries around the world are celebrating the 216th anniversary of the Grito de Dolores, including Spain, Poland, Hungary and this year, Iran — which is projecting Mexico's flag on its most famous tower for the first time.
items.summary_en: Countries around the world marked the 216th anniversary of Mexico's Grito de Dolores. Iran joined in by shining Mexico's flag on its famous Azadi Tower in Tehran for the first time. It was a unique Independence Day tribute.
items.summary_ko: 전 세계 여러 나라가 멕시코의 그리토 데 돌로레스 216주년을 기념했다. 이란도 처음으로 테헤란의 유명한 아자디 타워에 멕시코 국기를 비추며 동참했다. 멕시코 독립기념일을 기리는 특별한 축하였다.
items.title_en: Tehran's Azadi Tower shows Mexican flag for the first time

items.raw_excerpt: Anteriormente el rostro de Chilevisión había lanzado bromas contra la orientación sexual del periodista.

items.raw_excerpt: The tournament director at the first-ever Oceania Women's Handball Championship believes Fiji, Cook Islands and Kiribati are on the right path in the sport.
